verdicts.novelty_survives: Survives both lists but with a narrowed claim. Neither the context prior-art list nor the surveys contain second-order-Tweedie guidance — but the generative-modeling literature does: TMPD (Boys et al. 2023, 'Tweedie Moment Projected Diffusions') computes posterior covariance via exactly this second-order Tweedie identity (via vjp) for diffusion inverse problems, and PiGDM uses a heuristic posterior covariance for the same purpose. TECV's surviving delta: (a) inequality/truncation factors handled by probit-EP with exact truncated-Gaussian moments (TMPD handles Gaussian likelihoods only), (b) frozen policy / action-chunk domain, (c) feasibility-mass Z as an honest infeasibility trigger, (d) the derived (not tuned) authority schedule, (e) joint safety-truncation x destination-factor product. That delta is real and paper-worthy, but the paper must cite TMPD/PiGDM or a reviewer will. vs our own soft-hinge pre-shaping: genuinely different (measured covariance, no gain, exactness statement). vs RMG/Q-VGM/Feng-Uehara line: distinct as claimed.
verdicts.math_sound: Core algebra verified correct: Fact 1 (v=(mu-x)/(1-tau)) checks from the interpolant; Fact 2 (grad mu = (tau/(1-tau)^2) Cov, so Sigma n costs one JVP) is the standard second-order Tweedie identity and the coefficient is right; Fact 3 (tilted posterior mean gives the marginal-preserving tilted velocity, so RRR's summed-score no-go is genuinely routed around) checks; the single-halfspace truncated-Gaussian update and the vanishing bound via the inverse Mills ratio are correct, including the elegant automatic late-tau decay. Three flags: (1) an UNNAMED bias source — integrating the baseline velocity for tau<0.1 then switching to the tilted velocity does not sample the tilt exactly even under ideal assumptions (initial-marginal mismatch at the switch); small but should be in the bias list. (2) For a real network grad mu is not symmetric (JVP != VJP); the r-JVP symmetrization of cross terms is ad hoc — fine in practice, but 'exact' language should be softened. (3) Local posterior Gaussianity mid-integration of a multimodal policy is the big idealization; acknowledged, and the cross-seed-dispersion mismatch detector is the right mitigation.
verdicts.feasible_on_stack: Yes, and cheaper than the proposal fears: JVPs go through the ~300M action expert with cached prefix KV, not the 3B VLM, so r=1-3 JVPs/step on surviving seeds is roughly +10-30% NFE, all jittable (fixed r_max masking, fixed-3-sweep EP, jax.scipy Phi/phi). The tau=0 singularity guard and PSD clamps are static-shape friendly. Main engineering risk is EP numerical behavior at tiny Z in bf16 — run EP scalars in fp32.
verdicts.joint_objective_real: Real. Safety truncations and the task destination factor are literal factors of one product measure whose mean is computed jointly; the tradeoff is mediated by the policy's own covariance geometry, and the hard sweep stays last. This is the only method of the six where safety and task interact inside a single velocity evaluation with an exactness story.
verdicts.one_liner: Strongest theory contribution of the six — a self-calibrated, gain-free, marginal-correct tilt with a derived schedule — provided it cites TMPD and demotes 'exact' to 'exact under named idealizations'.

verdicts.novelty_survives: The gap (GAP 1) is real and unfilled by any surveyed work — but APNR is a duplicate of DBNR from the other researcher (same core object: nullspace restitution of repair damage), and DBNR dominates it for prototyping. vs OC-Flow/Adjoint Matching the delta (state constraints, nullspace confinement, damage cap, inference-only, frozen policy) is genuine; vs DiRecT clearly distinct. Novelty survives, but within this portfolio it is the weaker twin.
verdicts.math_sound: Two substantive errors/hand-waves. (1) The lean-adjoint recursion lambda_k = (I + dtau grad v)^T lambda_{k+1} uses the UNREPAIRED Jacobian while the dynamics include the state-dependent repair r(x_k); ignoring dr/dx misprices task damage precisely in the regime APNR targets (repair active). Fixable — vjp through the full step fn including the jittable sweep — but as written the pricing theorem is first-order-wrong. (2) Mode A computes restitution for the recorded trajectory, then re-integrates; active sets shift under the new trajectory, so the damage cap is only approximately honored and downstream sweeps can re-strip what restitution added (churn). The clean parts: safety-neutrality-via-sweep-last is airtight; the damage cap (never restore more than was destroyed) is the tightest honesty device in either nullspace proposal and should be grafted onto DBNR. Corollaries 1-2 check.
verdicts.feasible_on_stack: Feasible: adjoint is through the action expert only, ~30 NFE-equivalents serial per chunk on the winner (+~35% chunk latency in Mode A). Mode B (lagged co-states) is honest but heuristic. More plumbing than DBNR for strictly less coverage (winner-only vs all seeds).
verdicts.joint_objective_real: Real — the co-state is a genuine first-order price of task progress and the restitution is confined to directions safety does not own. The 'restitution not trade' framing is correct and quotable.
verdicts.one_liner: Right gap, principled pricing, but dominated by its cheaper twin DBNR; keep the adjoint pass as offline telemetry (the safety-tax accounting figure) and graft its damage cap onto DBNR.

verdicts.novelty_survives: The DPI harm certificate is genuinely new in this space (no surveyed method states any unconditional distributional guarantee) — but it is duplicated by DPI-Shift from the other researcher; the two must merge. vs DSRL (RL-trained), Golden Ticket (offline constant), Start-Right-Arrive-Right (point inversion, no measure), noise-search lines: deltas hold. The chance-constraint program and importance-weighted counterfactuals are nice dressing but not the novel core.
verdicts.math_sound: DPI and Gaussian-KL formulas correct. One SHARED CRITICAL FLAW with DPI-Shift: the certificate as stated bounds the law of one pushforward sample, but the executed chunk is best-of-K=8 under repair; by tuple DPI the correct bound on the executed-chunk law is K*KL(Q||P) — 8x looser than claimed. Fixable by restating (per-seed law, or budget kappa/K), not fatal, but the headline sentence is currently wrong. Second problem is statistical, not mathematical: ridge-regressing endpoint scores on z in R^70 from K=8 pairs/chunk (plus a decaying stale buffer) is a near-hopeless estimation problem; beta_T early in an episode is noise, and the chance constraint is surrogate-level decoration (acknowledged). The certificate guarantees the method cannot hurt much — it does not prevent it from certifiably doing nothing, which is the likely empirical outcome.
verdicts.feasible_on_stack: Trivially feasible: closed-form ridge, 2-variable solver, static ring buffer, all jittable at chunk boundaries, zero extra NFEs. Cheapest to build of the six after HLMA.
verdicts.joint_objective_real: Formally joint (epsilon-constraint: max progress s.t. probabilistic margin floor), but the safety floor lives in a noisy linear surrogate, so operationally it is a task-steering method with a safety-flavored constraint; real safety remains the sweep's, which the proposal admits.
verdicts.one_liner: The certificate is the keeper, the surrogate is the corpse — merge its closed-loop kappa controller and counterfactual weights into DPI-Shift and fix the factor-K hole in the guarantee.

verdicts.novelty_survives: Survives: no surveyed method maintains cross-chunk statistical state (GAP 4 verbatim), and the two named objects — barrier-stack homotopy signatures of action chunks, and per-mode realized-vs-predicted margin bias — exist nowhere, including classical H-signature planning (Bhattacharya line), AEGIS, Pre-VLA, and our own route hysteresis. Closest paper: AEGIS (scalar threshold, discrete handoff); delta is large.
verdicts.math_sound: Signature proposition is plausible and honestly caveated (true homotopy invariant only under cylinder extension; over-the-top aliasing admitted). Empirical-Bernstein formula is correct. The safe-bandit guarantee's within-episode stationarity assumption is badly violated by task phases and the proposal says so. The fatal weakness is statistical starvation, which the proposal understates: with ~50-100 chunk boundaries per episode split across several modes and phases, n_m stays single-to-low-double digits, Bernstein intervals dominate the bias estimates, and the method provably degrades to the existing best-of-K for most of every episode. A cross-episode per-task ledger (n in the hundreds over a 20-50 episode eval) would fix this but changes the story to deployment-time adaptation — that variant should be the primary one.
verdicts.feasible_on_stack: Most feasible of all six: signs and dot products on quantities the sweep already computes, a 64-slot static ledger in the carry, and a read of margins already logged at 20 Hz. 4-6 day estimate is credible.
verdicts.joint_objective_real: Joint at selection granularity only — confidence-corrected margin floor (safety) with UCB progress objective (task). Real but thin: it re-ranks candidates the sampler already produced; it steers nothing.
verdicts.one_liner: Genuinely novel objects and the only proposal that closes the executed-prefix feedback loop, but within-episode sample starvation caps it at a strong ablation section, not a paper spine — promote the cross-episode ledger variant if built.

verdicts.novelty_survives: Survives cleanly. GAP 1 names this exact move as unfilled; DiRecT is the nearest published neighbor (optimizer-in-loop state-trajectory planner, no nullspace structure, no damage budget, no vanishing theorem, not a VLA); ACG manufactures a smoothness vector, not task; Q-VGM trains and fine-tunes. Against our own claims: the Riemannian metric min||d||_M only reweights what the repair removes — it cannot add progress back in the nullspace — so DBNR is a distinct second lexicographic stage, as argued. Stack-of-tasks nullspace hierarchies are classical robotics, and the paper must frame the transplant into denoising integration (plus the damage budget and vanishing theorem) as the contribution, not the projector.
verdicts.math_sound: Properties (i)-(iv) verified line-by-line and correct at exactly the linearization order of the base sweep — the honest 'same epistemic status as the repair itself' framing is right. Three flags: (1) budget b_k = beta0*||d_k|| + kappa*D_k spends against TOTAL repair magnitude, so restitution can exceed the task-aligned damage tau_k — adopt APNR's tighter cap (restore at most the damage) to make the 'never more aggressive than the unrepaired policy' claim available. (2) The 'zero new NFEs / microseconds' cost claim depends on whether the existing sweep's g_i already chain through grad v (exact) or drop the network Jacobian; if exact, Phi's gradient is one extra action-expert VJP per step (~+10% NFE) — cheap either way, but the claim as written is loose; I could not confirm which the stack does from the repo. (3) Restitution-repair chattering across steps is real; the flip-rate telemetry and slack floor epsilon_s are the right mitigations and must ship in v1.
verdicts.feasible_on_stack: Best of the six: one kernel, ~30 lines, masked QR/Cholesky with static padding, debt scalar in the scan carry, no host calls, applies to all K seeds. The 3-5 day estimate is believable; property tests (i)-(iv) are directly assertable numerically.
verdicts.joint_objective_real: The most structurally real of the six: safety fixes the cone (untouched, certificate-backed for ANY budget setting), task is restored only inside it and only in proportion to what safety removed. Critically it converts AD (a cost metric) into recovered progress, and the budget-invariant safety opens the alpha-tightening move that shifts the Pareto front rather than sliding along it — a mechanism, not a garnish.
verdicts.one_liner: GAP 1 verbatim, four one-line-checkable theorems, near-zero cost, one-kernel change, and a killable-in-one-day premise — the highest expected value per day of the portfolio.

verdicts.novelty_survives: The certificate is new (shared with KBST — merge them); the mechanism is not: D-Flow/OC-Flow backprop through the flow to optimize initial noise for a terminal objective, which the proposal names first — credit for honesty. Surviving deltas: measure-level mean shift preserving K-seed diversity (vs point optimization), exact KL budget with the DPI proximity certificate, online warm-started chunk-rate operation, joint safety+task desirability, and the principled division of labor against 2606.02884's two failure classes (repair = within-mode, shift = mode selection). That composite is novel; each ingredient alone is not.
verdicts.math_sound: DPI, Gaussian KL, low-rank-warp KL, and the reparametrized gradient identity all check. Same factor-K certificate hole as KBST: the executed chunk is best-of-8, so the honest bound on the executed law is 8*kappa nats, not kappa — restate or divide the budget. The 'certificate bounds proximity, not safety or success' honesty is exactly right and should be the paper's framing. Nonconvex stall and stale-warm-start failure modes are acknowledged with sane mitigations (signature-change reset ties nicely to HLMA).
verdicts.feasible_on_stack: More feasible than the proposal's own risk assessment: the checkpointed VJP flows only through the ~300M action expert with frozen prefix KV, so 10-step unrolled backward fits comfortably under 32GB and K'=2-3 VJPs cost ~40-60 action-expert forward-equivalents per chunk (+50-75% chunk-rate compute) — viable, with the every-other-chunk fallback. The day-3 go/no-go on memory profiling is the right plan. Differentiating the unrepaired rollout in v1 is the correct simplification.
verdicts.joint_objective_real: Real at basin-selection granularity: F couples margin and progress so mass moves toward jointly safe-and-progressing basins, and the only trade is steering authority vs certified proximity — reportable per chunk. Safety itself remains the sweep's, stated plainly.
verdicts.one_liner: The right complement to within-mode methods (attacks the mode-selection failure gradient guidance provably cannot fix) with the field's first unconditional distributional certificate — after fixing the factor-8 hole and absorbing KBST's kappa controller.

recommendation:
Prototype DBNR first, TECV second. They act at different loci (post-repair restitution vs pre-repair velocity), are composable, and together cover GAP 1, G3, and GAP 6.

DBNR (3-5 days, highest EV/day). Graft APNR's tighter damage cap (restore at most the task-aligned velocity the repair removed) so the bounded-aggression theorem holds, and keep APNR's adjoint pass as offline telemetry for the safety-tax figure. Cheapest discriminating experiment — before writing the kernel: replay logged high-FAR episodes (Long L1, one Level II cell) and, from recorded sweep internals (G rows, d_k, x1_hat), compute offline (a) the removed task-aligned velocity tau_k and (b) the restitution headroom ||P_k w_k||/||w_k||. One day, zero integration. Kill criteria: if repairs rarely remove task-aligned velocity (tau_k ~ 0) or the nullspace rarely contains the task direction (headroom ~ 0 whenever tau_k > 0), the method is dead. If alive, ship the kernel with property tests (i)-(iv) plus active-set flip-rate telemetry, then a 20-episode A/B at matched CAR on the same two cells; success = TSR up with CAR unchanged and recouped task-aligned AD.

TECV (4-6 days, the theory paper's spine). Its entire premise is that the network's implicit Tweedie covariance is meaningful. Cheapest discriminating experiment: on existing logs, at mid-tau steps, measure directional covariance n^T Sigma n via one JVP along each active barrier normal and correlate (per chunk, rank correlation) with empirical cross-seed endpoint dispersion along the same normals — K=8 endpoints are already computed, so this is ~1 day offline with a handful of JVPs. Kill criterion: no correlation means self-calibration is fiction and only the un-novel fixed-gain variant remains. If alive, implement the single-active-face closed-form variant first (exact truncated-Gaussian update, no EP) and A/B it before building the EP module. Cite TMPD/PiGDM in the writeup.

Defer DPI-Shift/KBST (merge them, fix the factor-K certificate hole) as the follow-up for mode-selection failures DBNR/TECV cannot touch; fold HLMA's cross-episode ledger in as an ablation if time permits.
